question.text: Under SEBI KRA Regulations, what must a KRA do within 10 working days of receipt of initial/updated KYC documents from an intermediary?

answer.text: Complete the validation of all KYC records
Upload the documents to SEBI's central database
Send a letter to the client confirming the details thereof and maintain proof of dispatch

explanation.text: The Logic: The SEBI KRA guidelines state that a KRA shall send a letter to the client within 10 working days of receipt of the initial or updated KYC documents from the intermediary, confirming the details thereof and maintaining proof of dispatch. The Trap: Option A seems like the priority, but the specific 10-working-day obligation set out in the guidelines is the client confirmation letter, not completion of validation. Note: Maintaining proof of dispatch of the confirmation letter is part of the KRA's obligation under this rule.
